script: Tell her this so she stops seeing you as just a friend. These four lines show interest without sounding desperate. Number one: I really enjoy spending time with you. I get the feeling that knowing you deeper would be even more interesting. Number two: You're so easy to talk to. Now I'm curious what a date with you would be like. Number three: I don't usually invest this much time in someone. That's why I wanna get to know you better. Number four: I enjoyed meeting you, and I won't lie: I have no intention of being just another friend in your life. Honesty with confidence works better than waiting for a perfect moment that never comes. Comment the word LINES, and I'll send you my free playbook.
